say:2:1410524001:1.text: Alright, Pointy Ears, this is where we part. Make sure you take the same route back.
say:2:1410524001:1.source_cn: 祭司小子，我们待会要直接离开了，你记得原路返回。

say:3:1410524002:1.text: Huh? Um... you're just letting me go like this?
say:3:1410524002:1.source_cn: 咦！你们要回去了？呃，我是说，你们就直接把我放走了？

choice_prompt:4:1410524002.text: Huh? Um... you're just letting me go like this?
choice_prompt:4:1410524002.source_cn: 咦！你们要回去了？呃，我是说，你们就直接把我放走了？

say:5:1410524003:1.text: How could I possibly travel with you evil intruders!
say:5:1410524003:1.source_cn: 你们可是邪恶的潜入者，我怎么可能和你们同行……

say:6:1410524005:1.text: Enough chit-chat; you should hurry back home. After all, it seems like your people can't even step foot on the surface.
say:6:1410524005:1.source_cn: 那就好，你快点回去吧，毕竟你们艾塞勒似乎是无法踏足地表的。

say:7:1410524006:1.text: Hmph, what's so good about the surface anyway? The underground is the real paradise!
say:7:1410524006:1.source_cn: 哼，毕竟地表上毫无可取之处，我们深居的地底才是真正的乐...

choice_prompt:8:1410524006.text: Hmph, what's so good about the surface anyway? The underground is the real paradise!
choice_prompt:8:1410524006.source_cn: 哼，毕竟地表上毫无可取之处，我们深居的地底才是真正的乐园……！

say:9:1410524007:1.text: N-not really... but Her Majesty speaks only the truth, and there's no reason to doubt it!
say:9:1410524007:1.source_cn: 唔……女王所说的就是事实。女王恩泽萨洛克兰，没理由骗我们！
say:9:1410524007:1.male: N-not really... but Her Majesty speaks only the truth, and there's no reason to doubt it!
say:9:1410524007:1.female: N-not really... but Her Majesty speaks only the truth, and there's no reason to doubt it!

say:10:1410524009:1.text: Oh, you're adorable. Listen, the cruelest tricks aren't played by your enemies. They're played by the ones you trust.
say:10:1410524009:1.source_cn: 你还真是个小孩子啊，天真！这世界的残酷真相之一就是其他...

say:11:1410524010:1.text: Don't pretend like you know everything! That's it—I'm coming with you!
say:11:1410524010:1.source_cn: 你！不许你这么说！既然如此，我反倒要跟着你们了！

say:12:1410524011:1.text: Let's go! I want to see the surface with my own eyes!
say:12:1410524011:1.source_cn: 走吧！我要看看，你们说的地表到底是怎样的情况！

say:13:1410524012:1.text: That's your call! Just remember, once you see what it's really like up there, no take-backs—or tears.
say:13:1410524012:1.source_cn: 这是你自己说的哦！待会看到真相后可不要哇哇大哭。

say:14:1410524013:1.text: Look! There's a minecart over there. Seems like it still works!
say:14:1410524013:1.source_cn: 走吧，那边有个矿车。看着像是能正常使用的样子！
say:14:1410524013:1.male: Look! There's a minecart over there. Seems like it still works!
say:14:1410524013:1.female: Look! There's a minecart over there. Seems like it still works!

say:15:1410524014:1.text: Even if it doesn't, I can get it running in no time!
say:15:1410524014:1.source_cn: 别担心，就算坏掉，我也能很快修好！
say:15:1410524014:1.male: Even if it doesn't, I can get it running in no time!
say:15:1410524014:1.female: Even if it doesn't, I can get it running in no time!

say:17:1410524008:1.text: Her Majesty's teachings can't be wrong!
say:17:1410524008:1.source_cn: 女王的教诲绝不可能出错！
say:17:1410524008:1.male: Her Majesty's teachings can't be wrong!
say:17:1410524008:1.female: Her Majesty's teachings can't be wrong!

say:18:1410524004:1.source_cn: 哈，我就知道……不对！什么叫“也”啊？！我可没有舍不得你们！
